native_dcm.uncertainty: sample SD over training seeds; no between-source variance
native_dcm.test_scope: previously opened source run 988976; not an independent confirmatory test

settings.scope: Vertex-projected rectangular analysis window, not segmented active detector or proton magnetic transport.

reweighting.policy: Class thresholds and common class composition refitted in every replicate

truth_controls.scope: Post-hoc MC truth diagnostic. Not experimental centrality; matching this proxy cannot exclude other composition differences.

retrospective.scope: retrospective feasibility on reused corrected-SMASH data with frozen DCM-trained weights; no holdout, no fitting; MC truth T0-C3 (C3 with reconstructed energy), reconstructed C4

training.scope: cross-fitted test files of corrected, deduplicated SMASH Xe+Cs 2.87 GeV/nucleon (U_sym 0/18/90 MeV), split 848ebf49; each file scored only by models that never saw it; the files were scored by the frozen transfer before, so not a blind holdout

definitions.auc/ap: ROC-AUC and average precision of cl_score against the native label, per fold, then averaged over folds per seed (reconstructed score, MC-truth label)
definitions.purity/efficiency: at the cut frozen on fold validation (count purity 0.70)
definitions.bias/mae: mean and mean absolute e_pred - e_true over all MC-positive clusters, GeV (MC-truth label and energy, reconstructed energy)

delta_bias_window.note: seed SE excludes the file-sampling error shared by all seeds; compare against the per-arm boot SDs

split.rule: per potential: rank by sha256(salt+tag+':'+hits_sha+vacs_sha) of the kept content, part = rank mod 6; fold k: test = truth-bound groups of P_2k and P_2k+1, val = P_(2k+2) mod 6, train = the other three parts

pdf.visual_check: All final pages inspected: readable figures/tables; no clipping, overlaps, broken glyphs or missing floats. Visible production/release TODOs retained.
pdf.remaining_tex_warning: nameref: definition of label has changed (package compatibility warning)

figure_checks: Text bounds inside canvas asserted by generator
All displayed data and uncertainty bounds asserted inside panels
Figures generated at print size; embedded TrueType; no grid; ticks on four sides
external_gates: Production run cards/versions/potential coefficients and E_sym mapping
Generator seeds, b sampling and final export provenance
Public license, immutable data/weight deposit and release
Coauthor scope, authorship and funding approval

student_leakage.definition:
Stratify saved student test scores by identical training candidate inputs.

No model fitting, inference, cut choice or new holdout is performed. Positional
eigenvectors are excluded because eigensolver sign conventions are arbitrary;
the signature covers the ordered six input features and exact directed edges.

full_transfer.scope: Retrospective canonical-file conditional SMASH cluster metrics; no fresh holdout
full_transfer.uncertainty: sample SD of three DCM training seeds, not MC/source uncertainty

zeroSpot.event_key: canonical detector member + Row; arms kept together

defaultSpot.event_key: canonical detector member + Row; arms kept together

bigSpot.event_key: canonical detector member + Row; arms kept together

purity_preflight.population: Selection S only; bootstrap SDs and energy-band purities, no alternative-cut contrast inspected
purity_preflight.error_scope: Values copied from the committed review; no uncertainty on these SD estimates is supplied; not a completed primary scan result

next_background_protocol.status: committed draft; no accepted result in this snapshot
next_background_protocol.question: Per-band background correction at frozen target purity 0.70; generator/model dependence primary, corrected R_n secondary
